item.title: Detecting decimal from Oracle number type
item.description: Motivation Detecting specific dataypes for parquet file generation Data https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/arnavsmayan/fitness-tracker-dataset Version Oracle Database 23ai Free Release 23.0.0.0.0 Setup Imported dataset 5 times for a total of 5 million rows Created index CREATE INDEX sleep_hrs_idx ON FITNESS.FITNESS_TRACKER ("sleep_hours"); Tests Query Time SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FITNESS.FITNESS_TRACKER WHERE ROUND("sleep_hours") != "sleep_hours"; 0.100s SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FITNESS.FITNESS_TRACKER WHERE TRUNC("sleep_hours") != "sleep_hours"; 0.100s SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FITNESS.FITNESS_TRACKER WHERE FLOOR("sleep_hours") != "sleep_hours"; 0.107s SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FITNESS.
